# CloudBoost

> CloudBoost is an independent macOS menu bar app for diagnosing gaming stutter, app traffic, latency, jitter and packet loss during cloud gaming, remote play and native Mac gaming sessions.

CloudBoost requires macOS 12 or later. The current 5.1.1 preview is for Apple Silicon. The universal 5.1.0 preview supports Intel and Apple Silicon. Version 4.4.6 is archived for existing 4.x customers.

Free includes manual app traffic checks and basic session monitoring. Eligible users can try three complete PRO sessions without an account or card. CloudBoost 5 PRO starts at US$12, paid once for one Mac. It adds saved game setups, session history, comparisons and automation. Existing PRO 4.x licenses remain valid on the archived generation.

The app can help isolate local and network conditions around a stutter. Route latency can differ from game-server ping. Public results describe observed sessions and do not establish guaranteed FPS or latency improvements.

## Guides and evidence

- [First traffic check](https://getcloudboost.site/start.html#traffic-check): Check app traffic and repeat a measurement.
- [GeForce NOW stutter on Mac](https://getcloudboost.site/guides/geforce-now-mac-lag.html): Investigate jitter despite a low average ping.
- [Mac jitter and packet loss](https://getcloudboost.site/guides/mac-gaming-jitter-packet-loss.html): Test local Wi-Fi, external routes, VPN and loaded-network conditions.
- [Mac gaming guide index](https://getcloudboost.site/guides.html): GeForce NOW, Xbox Cloud Gaming, Boosteroid, remote play, native games and compatibility guides.
- [GunBound GIS community guide](https://getcloudboost.site/gunbound.html): Local Wine setup tested on one M1 Mac. CloudBoost verifies setup files and opens a local launcher with permission.
- [GunBound GIS em português](https://getcloudboost.site/pt/gunbound.html): Guia comunitário de instalação com Wine.
- [GunBound GIS en español](https://getcloudboost.site/es/gunbound.html): Guía comunitaria de instalación con Wine.
- [Measured League of Legends session](https://getcloudboost.site/results/league-of-legends-pro-session.html): Observational report, method, screenshots and raw samples.
- [Independent MacMagazine coverage](https://macmagazine.com.br/post/2026/06/01/cloudboost-otimiza-a-experiencia-de-jogos-na-nuvem-no-mac/): Portuguese coverage of the project.

## Support and trust

- [Official support](https://getcloudboost.site/support.html): Receipt recovery, license help and changing Macs.
- [CloudBoost 4.x archive](https://getcloudboost.site/pro.html): Reinstall the final 4.x build with an existing license.
- [Trust and permissions](https://getcloudboost.site/trust.html): Distribution, app behavior and macOS permissions.
- [Privacy](https://getcloudboost.site/privacy.html): Data collection and optional analytics.
